observations.code_quote: The Email threads tab lists matched customer communication from Conversations. `accountEmailThreadsLogic` fetches paginated summaries that include subject, preview, customer participants, owner, message count, and latest activity. Expanding one row fetches messages in server-bounded pages and renders them in source-timestamp order. The list endpoint never includes message bodies. Both list and detail endpoints require account viewer access plus ticket viewer access because subjects, previews, addresses, and bodies are customer communication. The logic reports unexpected failures without including any email content in analytics or exception metadata.
